classifier: Deterministic controller emits an enum from evidence; free-form condition text and LLM opinion do not select a disposition. Unknown classification uses safe fallback.

cases.next: Only receipt/state reconciliation; no effect retry until outcome resolved and successor admission authorized
Reconcile missing SOT receipts under bounded authorized successor; never merge again
Wait for explicit authorized decision; unchanged input does not wake
Approved repin and affected verification in a bounded new attempt; no old receipt promotion
Fence outstanding work; no heartbeat extension or automatic new budget
Record final decision; no automatic successor
Preserve recoverable checkout and refs; CLOSED only after accepted cleanup or retained-worktree disposition
Fail closed; record source evidence and require classification before further controlled action

onEntry: Atomically persist disposition, release active worker capacity, fence controlled writer, preserve effect safety quarantine and required receipt reconciliation; no automatic back edge
multipleFailures: Use first matching priority; UNKNOWN_EFFECT safety quarantine remains even if closeout or deadline is also incomplete
